none: PAS SUSS-7089A3: Copper alloy Roman nummas, House of Constantine, AD330-335
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Roman nummus, House of Constantine (AD.306-361), Reece period 17, unknown mint, AD330-335. GLOR-IA EXERC-ITVS reverse. Obverse shows bust right, although badly worn. The obverse legend is missing. Reverse shows two soldiers with one standard between. Legend: GLOR-IA EXER[C-ITVS]. The obverse is in better condition, and still possible to see part of the legend. There is some damage…
